desc: Parse input preserving the given sorted order of buildings by X-coordinate.
Derive that all buildings are visible iff s_i=(H_i-h)/X_i is strictly increasing, so "not all visible" equals {h <= max_i t_i} with t_i=(H_{i-1}X_i - H_i X_{i-1})/(X_i - X_{i-1}).
Compute the maximum t_i over adjacent pairs using exact integer cross-multiplication to avoid float loss.
Output -1 if N==1 or max t_i < 0, else output max t_i with 18-decimal precision; verified against all 4 samples.
